purpose: Process a separately frozen Physical Review Letters cohort to reach at least 20 cumulative accepted recent-source Temporal benchmark families.
interpretation: Operational benchmark production after observing a cumulative total of 12 accepted families from earlier cohorts. Report this cohort separately; it is not a preregistered estimate of conversion rate and does not identify a causal pipeline effect.

source_policy.census: Official Crossref ISSN census in the inclusive journal publication-date window.
source_policy.source_requirement: The fixed versioned arXiv source archive contains at least one TeX file.
source_policy.fixed_order: All 91 eligible records in the accepted order of prl_relation_candidate_audit.json.

time_window.date_rule: earliest_public_date is the earlier of journal publication and arXiv first submission; the fixed arXiv version must be public by the window end

record_linkage.identity_evidence: A subject-asserted Crossref has-preprint relation must point to a 2026 arXiv identifier that resolves exactly through official arXiv id_list metadata.
record_linkage.journal_doi_check: When official arXiv metadata reports a related journal DOI, it must equal the Crossref journal DOI. An absent related DOI is not affirmative DOI evidence and is not a conflict.

target.rule: Count at most one family per source paper, and only after a nonempty minimal ScienceCard, separate-context source-review retention, deterministic construction, and passing Identification and Discovery known-truth validation.
target.processing: Process all 91 frozen sources; do not stop when the cumulative target is reached and do not replace failures.
target.family_identifier_rule: The compiler uses frozen source order plus family_index_offset, yielding temporal_source_2001 through temporal_source_2091 and avoiding cross-cohort identifier collisions.

authoring_engine.runtime_model_label: unknown unless exposed by the session

review.execution: A Code Agent context that did not author the card reviews the fixed source packet and frozen ScienceCard.
review.independence_claim: Process separation only; this is not independent human or domain-expert review.
review.release_requirement: Human source review remains required before public benchmark release.

temporal_claim.reason: The authoring engine knowledge cutoff and immutable snapshot are not documented.
temporal_claim.prohibited_description: Post-cutoff, unseen, or contamination-free benchmark cases

main_pipeline.emergency_adapter_scope: EXP-TEMPORAL-PRODUCTION-003 only; it does not replace the API runner
